description: Send a message in an existing conversation. Accepts room_name (from list_conversations) or talent_slug (from search_talent). Use start_conversation first if no conversation exists yet. Sending takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is sent, and the reply is a preview of the exact text with a confirm_token; calling again with the same message and that token sends it. The candidate reads it as coming from the user's company and it can't be unsent, so show the user the preview and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

confirm_token.description: Leave out to get a preview; nothing is sent. Pass the token from that preview, with the same message, to send it

talent_slug.description: Talent slug (from search_talent results) — resolves to room name automatically

name: send_message
title: Send message to candidate
